Usage: yantra do|discover [options] <goal>

Run a multi-turn web agent that uses Yantra tools and publishes a Brief.

Arguments:
  goal                          browser or web goal to accomplish

Options:
  --provider <name>             agent model provider
  --model <id>                  provider-scoped model id
  --thinking <level>            provider reasoning level
  --auth-secret <ref>           runtime model-key secret reference
  --max-duration <duration>     whole-run wall-clock duration
  --max-tokens <n>              cumulative provider token ceiling
  --tool-timeout <duration>     timeout for one tool call
  --tool-retries <n>            retries after an identical tool failure
  --confirm-timeout <duration>  maximum live consent wait
  --no-llm                      force the deterministic no-model path
  --no-screenshots              no screenshots this run (vision assist and saved
                                captures)
  --turn-timeout <duration>     thinking time allowed in one provider turn
  --browser <source>            browser source for this invocation (auto,
                                managed, or system)
  --browser-path <path>         absolute path to a Chrome or Chromium executable
  --allow-host <host>           restrict outbound work to a host (repeatable)
                                (default: [])
  --save-as <name>              on success, promote the browser trace into a
                                saved, replayable workflow
  --json                        emit progress and outcome as NDJSON (default:
                                false)
  --open                        open the generated brief.html in the default
                                browser (default: false)
  --template <name|tag|path>    render the result with a saved name, tag, or
                                Markdown template path
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Protect user-supplied values from the model with `@{value}` or `@password{value}`. Malformed markers are validation errors (exit 1).
